title: Adapter interface, local config and leg cache
goal: Providers are swappable and legs are fetched once
acceptance: Key and provider choice from git-ignored `public/config.local.json`, with a committed example file without keys
Pure leg cache keyed by provider, profile, from and to, with tests
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no owner places, home address, photos, routes or API keys in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-25 in the upfront step plan: scoped to one PR, at most 1 focused day(s). Not a measurement.
